usage.source_scope: The real-mocap/video motion-retargeting pipeline and curated traffic-compatible pedestrian motion set; automotive injury and braking metrics are not imported as DTR authority.
usage.project_application: For a later CARLA source experiment, freeze map, weather, wearer route, actor count, spawn geometry, and DTR algorithm, then replace one deterministic scripted-motion arm with a matched retargeted-motion arm covering hesitation, acceleration, stop-go, return, nonlinear crossing, posture change, and occlusion reappearance.
usage.modifications: Score unchanged DTR CONTACT, false segments, lead time, event F1, and dropout recovery by behavior stratum. Keep current frozen CARLA protocols and any concurrent natural-dynamics work untouched.
usage.expected_effect: Expose route-risk failures hidden by deterministic pedestrian scripts. Stop if the retargeted arm adds no new behavior/event strata or if integration cost dominates the information gain; do not add more weather or static scenery as a substitute.

evaluation.setup: Candidate matched scripted-versus-retargeted CARLA behavior experiment after current frozen work terminates.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Retargeted CARLA motion remains synthetic behavior evidence. It cannot establish natural frequency, wearable perception, source-disjoint generalization, Android behavior, BLV user benefit, product reliability, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary WACV paper reviewed for retargeting approximately 30K real motions into 4,730 traffic-compatible SMPL motions and its CARLA benchmark boundary.

history.change: Added as a later matched behavior-distribution candidate and explicitly held outside current frozen or concurrent CARLA work.
